# simc

SimulationCraft local workflow CLI.

## Global options

Pass these before the subcommand: `simc --pretty <command> ...`.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--pretty` | boolean | false | Pretty-print JSON for human reading. Default output is compact JSON. |
| `--compact` | boolean | false | Truncate long string fields to reduce payload size. |
| `--fields` | str (repeatable) |  | Return only selected fields (dot paths). Repeat or pass comma-separated values. |
| `--fields-strict` | boolean | false | Fail when a requested --fields dot-path is missing from the payload. |
| `--profile` | str |  | Output profile preset: agent (default compact JSON) or human (pretty JSON). |
| `--compact-max-chars` | int range | 280 | Maximum string length before --compact truncation adds an ellipsis. |
| `--repo-root` | str |  | Override the local SimulationCraft checkout path. |

## simc doctor

Report SimulationCraft repo readiness, binary version, and per-command capabilities.

## simc repo

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--set-root` | str |  | Persist an explicit SimulationCraft repo root. |
| `--clear-root` | boolean | false | Clear the persisted explicit SimulationCraft repo root. |

## simc compare-apls

Sim a base APL against labelled variants and rank them by DPS.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `harness_path` | str | required | Harness profile path without APL actions. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--base-apl` | str | required | Base APL path. |
| `--base-label` | str | base | Label for the base APL. |
| `--variant` | str (repeatable) |  | Variant in label=path form. Repeat as needed. |
| `--iterations` | int range | 250 | Iterations per variant. |
| `--threads` | int range | 1 | Threads per variant. |
| `--out-dir` | str |  | Optional directory for generated profiles and JSON reports. |
| `--validate-first / --skip-validate` | boolean | true | Validate each generated profile before the full comparison. |
| `--report-out` | str |  | Optional path to save the structured comparison JSON. |

| `--talents` | str |  | WoW export, Wowhead talent-calc URL with build code, SimC talents string, or talents=... line. |
| `--class-talents` | str |  | Split class talents string. |
| `--spec-talents` | str |  | Split spec talents string. |
| `--hero-talents` | str |  | Split hero talents string. |
| `--actor-class` | str |  | Actor class such as monk or evoker. |
| `--spec` | str |  | Spec name such as mistweaver. |
| `--enable` | str (repeatable) |  | Enabled talent names. Repeat or pass comma-separated values. |
| `--disable` | str (repeatable) |  | Disabled talent names. Repeat or pass comma-separated values. |

## simc first-cast

Time the first cast of an action across several short sims.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `profile_path` | str | required | Path to a SimulationCraft profile to execute. |
| `action` | str | required | Action name to time. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--seeds` | int range | 5 | Number of timing samples. |
| `--max-time` | int range | 60 | Fight length for each short sim. |
| `--targets` | int range | 1 | Active target count. |
| `--fight-style` | str | Patchwerk | Fight style for the short sims. |

## simc log-actions

Report when actions were first scheduled and performed in a SimC combat log.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `log_path` | str | required | Path to a SimulationCraft combat log. |
| `actions` | str | required | One or more action names to inspect. |

## simc sync

Pull the latest SimulationCraft sources into the local checkout.

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--allow-dirty` | boolean | false | Allow git pull even if the repo has local changes. |

## simc build

Build the local SimulationCraft binary with cmake.

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--target` | str |  | Optional build target passed to cmake. |

## simc sim

Run a profile through the local SimC binary and summarize the JSON report.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `profile_path` | str |  | Path to a SimulationCraft profile. Omit or pass '-' to read from stdin. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--preset` | str | quick | Run preset: quick or high-accuracy. |
| `--iterations` | int range |  | Override the preset iteration count. |
| `--max-time` | int range |  | Override max fight length in seconds. |
| `--fight-style` | str |  | Optional fight style override. |
| `--threads` | int range |  | Optional thread override. Leave unset to use SimC defaults. |
| `--targets` | int range |  | Optional desired target count override. |
| `--vary-combat-length` | float range |  | Optional combat length variance override. |
| `--profile-text` | str |  | Inline SimulationCraft profile text. |
| `--json-out` | str |  | Optional path for the raw SimC JSON report. |

## simc compare-builds

Diff a base talent build against one or more other builds, per tree.

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--base` | str | required | Base build: WoW export, Wowhead talent-calc URL with build code, or talents=... line. |
| `--other` | str (repeatable) | required | Build to compare against base. Repeat for multiple builds. |
| `--tree` | str (repeatable) |  | Limit diff to specific trees (class, spec, hero). Omit for all. |
| `--actor-class` | str |  | Actor class such as druid. |
| `--spec` | str |  | Spec name such as balance. |

## simc modify-build

Apply talent swaps, additions, and removals to a build and re-encode it.

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--talents` | str | required | Base build: WoW export, Wowhead talent-calc URL with build code, or talents=... line. |
| `--swap-class-tree-from` | str |  | Replace class tree from this build. |
| `--swap-spec-tree-from` | str |  | Replace spec tree from this build. |
| `--swap-hero-tree-from` | str |  | Replace hero tree from this build. |
| `--add` | str (repeatable) |  | Add or set talent: 'name:rank' or 'entry_id:rank'. Repeat as needed. |
| `--remove` | str (repeatable) |  | Remove talent by name or entry_id. Repeat as needed. |
| `--actor-class` | str |  | Actor class such as druid. |
| `--spec` | str |  | Spec name such as balance. |
